INT. BAR - There is a HOLLER at the top of the stairs. Everyone turns.
Is it clear?!
Yeah.
Is there a gun pointing at you?
Nah, I got the gun. Boss Man hobbles down the stairs with the help of Tuffy. His foot is a bloody mess. He is holding a .38.
Alright goddamn it! Who shot me!? Who did it!? Belle and Bartender move to his aid.
My goddamn foot is gone! Who fuckin' shot me? Who fuckin' shot me!?
(motioning to Heroine) Her fella.
My husband...
Well, where's the sonuvabitch!?
He's dead.
What? (noticing destruction) What the hell happened down here?! Boss Man looks to Bozo.
I didn't do it! It was fuckin' monsters, asshole!
Jesus Christ on the cross... someone make sense.
Easy. We're surrounded by something the likes none of you have ever seen before. Some kind of animals. Real fast, volatile, predators. One went through three of your patrons like nothing.
So, your dead hubby shot me twice, three of my customers have been eaten, and there are angry creatures outside?
He only shot you once.
Huh?
(re: Bartender) He shot you the other time.
It was an accident. Sorry. Boss Man squints skeptically. Adulterer points to GRANDPA BEAST'S HEAD on the bar.
Look at it!
Fan-fuckin-tastic.
My god... what is that?
That's one piece of four problems.
Please elaborate.

That head over there, that's the oldest of the bunch, looked like the Grandpa. We caught the little one, Junior, in the cooler there. As we've seen, what he lacks in size he more than makes up for in speed.
And the rest of 'em?
Unfortunately, the worst of 'em are still outside. NOTE: As Heroine describes each beast, we see a slight glimpse of their virtues, hidden mainly by shadows and fog.

The next one is taller, but all out of proportion. Like a "teen beast." EXT. PRAIRIE LAND - TEEN BEAST has a big head and awkward body. He clumsily moves and seems uncomfortable in his own skin. HEROINE (V.O.) He was spastic, clumsy, but deadly just the same. INT. BAR FRONT - Heroine tends to her scratched arm.

I just took the eye out of the mother. She calculates, guiding the attacks. EXT. PRAIRIE LAND - MOMMA BEAST flashes out from the dark. She's shorter than Teen, but much wider. She has a big mouth and NATIONAL GEOGRAPHIC BOOBS that hang down to her waist. She covers her stabbed right eye and SCREECHES. INT. BAR - Heroine taps her right eye.
If you are face to face with her, dive left.
And the last one is the --
Father. The biggest, the strongest... EXT. PRAIRIE LAND - A blur of muscles, bloody fur, and teeth. INT. BAR -- CONTINUOUS The entire bar stares at Heroine with their mouths agape.
No sign of any weaknesses. No sign at all. He's an eating machine.
Of all the friggin' bars to be stuck in.
That's not it. Four are here, but there's three others... which I can't account for. Heroine eyes the room.
We need to lock this place down. Is everyone in this room?
Oh my god! My son! My SON! Tuffy races toward the staircase to the SECOND FLOOR.
Wait! Tuffy is halfway up the stairs.
Cody! Mommy's coming! Mommy's coming!
Stop her!
Hey!
Tuffy BURSTS through the door. Cody sits by the TV, unmoved.
Mommy -- Tuffy pulls Cody into her arms. Heroine and Bartender halt to guard the doorway. Heroine spots a SMALL PORTAL WINDOW.
Oh sweetheart! What was I thinking? Mommy is never gonna let you go!
Let's lock off this room.

(moving to exit) Never, ever, never. Never, ever, never, baby. I love you -- SMASH! Papa Beast BURSTS through the portal window and RIPS Cody's torso from Tuffy's grasp. Tuffy holds his DANGLING ARMS. Blood sprays everywhere.

Papa Beast LUNGES at Tuffy! Bartender SHOOTS, nailing Papa Beast. He hisses, but can't fit through the small window. Bartender aims again for a kill shot, but Papa Beast projectile vomits Cody's remains at Bartender. Papa Beast retracts out the portal window. Heroine SLAMS the wood shutters closed. Tuffy drops Cody's arms. Bug-eyed. She moves, zombie-like, to the staircase. Bartender follows, covered in Papa Beast's bile. Heroine locks the staircase door shut.
Damn it.
Beer Guy stares at the bile covered Bartender.
Oh god... He hands him a towel. Tuffy slowly walks towards the rest of the patrons. The blood on her face and chest tells them what happened. The horror hits home. Heroine eyes the destroyed phone.
(to Tuffy) Are you -- Heroine puts a hand up to silence Coach.
Just let her be... please. Is that the only phone? Bartender emerges from the back holding a mess of plastic and wires.
The back phone is wrecked, too. Trampy's eyes light up and she digs through her purse.
This is really happening. I can't believe this is really happening. Grandpa and Grandma have calmly re-taken their seats.
What'd you say?

I didn't say anything. Bartender hesitantly tosses a wash towel over the Grandpa Beast head at the end of the bar. Para is awkwardly trying to fix the back of his wheelchair. Belle moves over to help and sees a mess of wires coming from the wheelchair's back rest.
Thank you, but I don't need any help --
What's this? A power magnet or something?
No. It's nothing. Belle puts together his scam with a smirk.
I didn't peg you for a con man.
Hey, it pays more than the couch.
Lots of stuff around here does. Trampy pulls out a CELLULAR PHONE from her purse.
Here! The group looks over. Adulterer GRABS it.
Hey!
Back off! Beer Guy walks from behind the bar.
So, what now? Did those things leave?
Why don't you go check it out?
Fuck no.
(into cell phone) I have a signal! I have -- Diane? Diane listen to me... get the kids and get in the basement... do it right now... Trampy stares with grief in her eyes.
I'll explain later. Not now! I'm at a bar... look... shut up! JUST SHUT

characterDialogue.character: UP AND GET IN THE FUCKING BASEMENT,
characterDialogue.dialogue: DIANE! Diane! Diane?... Hello? Damn it! I lost the signal! Adulterer looks at the phone a bit dazed.
Okay. Okay. Look now, I gotta get outta here! I gotta go! My wife... See my wife is alone... She could be in trouble. I GOTTA GO! He moves towards the front door. Heroine moves into his path.
I wouldn't do that. Adulterer, violently grabs Heroine to shove her away.
Fuck you, bitch! Heroine nails Adulterer with THREE HITS to the chin, throat and chest, flipping him to the floor. She pulls a KNIFE from her belt buckle and has it under Adulterer's chin.

You can risk your life, but not mine! My daughter's no more than twenty miles from here waiting for me. I have just as much reason to leave this place as you do. But I also know that if they're here, then they're not there yet. Adulterer squirms.
You understand me?
Get the fuck off...
You understand me!?
Yes!
Now pull that tough boy shit again and I'll slice you from neck to nuts! Adulterer nods obediently. Heroine removes the knife from his neck and plants it back into her buckle.
You can't keep me here. This is bullshit. Fuckin' bullshit. This is fucking BULLSHIT!
We can't risk letting them in.

(trembling, pissed) Right. Adulterer takes his seat. He looks over at the half bald Trampy. She looks at him, hurt. At the bar, Bozo puts the TV back into place, he jiggles with some wires in the back, bringing back the picture.
Anything?
Yeah, you got it. The bar takes notice. Trampy, cell phone in hand, paws through a phone book as she watches the broadcast.
See! This has to be isolated. That's a local broadcast. ON TV: The Newscaster reads the teleprompter.
And now, we head to our man on the scene with a live look at tomorrow's event in Red Mountain. Heroine eagerly looks on, moving closer to the TV.
My daughter's in Red Mountain. ON TV: There is an awkward pause from the Newscaster. The broadcast doesn't cut to the reporter.
Can you hear us? Apparently we're having some technical difficulties... Heroine sinks in her skin.
Oh no.
Oh, there we go! ON TV: A REPORTER, in an even worse suit, stands in a field with several people looking through telescopes.
That's right, the crowds are lining up early to witness tomorrow's meteorological phenomenon. Heroine sighs a gust of relief.
But always remember, don't look straight into the sun because a special filter is needed to avoid damaging your cornea. The Reporter beams.
And we're all looking forward to it tomorrow. Back to you. In the studio, the Newscaster smirks.
Thank you. And in other news... Roadie points to the TV.
That studio's local, we can call in.
I have a short wave radio upstairs. Trampy is already dialing on the cell.
I'm calling them... it's ringing!
They'd have a police scanner.
(into cell) Hello? Yes, we're at the United -- ON TV: the Newscaster continues his routine.

...it has been reported that the power outage -- A Beast arm REACHES in and TEARS off Newscaster's jaw. The bar gasps in horror as his blood sprays. ZAP! The broadcast cuts out, turning to static. Trampy screams and DROPS the cell, SHATTERING on impact.
Oh no! Oh fucking no! Heroine, tense, quells the rising panic.
Keep it together! I came from the east. That studio is south of here. For all we know, north and west are okay.
An associate of mine was coming in from the north, ain't heard a word from him in hours.
So, that leaves the west. Tuffy looks up from a booth, clearing her throat.
And Red Mountain. Your daughter. Heroine looks over, making eye contact.
Right.
This is goddamn depressing. At the door, Heroine slides a thick metal pole through the double door handles and takes out the Rust Red shotgun.
I've got some tools and extra planks in the kitchen, if we're on the same page here.
Let's work. INT. BAR - The last board is hammered into place as the survivors back away from the now re-enforced bar.
We'll it ain't pretty...
But its got teeth. BAM-BAM-BAM! Junior Beast bangs around in the ice cooler.
I think it's hungry again.
We have to kill it. (to Boss Man) Can you help? Boss Man hobbles over to the cooler and aims his .38. Junior Beast goes wild, trying to get out.
Fire in the hole! Bullets rip through the cooler. Junior squeals. More shots. Casings hit the ground. Smoke rises. Bozo leans in.

I think we got -- RAH! A tiny white arm fires out from the cooler GRABBING Bozo's leg. Bozo yelps. Moving quick, Tuffy grabs The Judge from Bartender and shoves the barrel into a hole. BLAM! Guts splatter. Bozo falls back unscathed. He catches his breath and looks to Tuffy. She is born again, seething.
You're welcome. She hands the shotgun back to Bartender.
Jesus, it took all that? All those bullets? How can we possibly fight off the others?
Aim for their orifices. Eyes, ears and mouth. From what I've seen, it's their only weakness.
(looking at the corpse) Looks like they're soft on the inside like any other animal. Trick is to get in there and do the damage.
Maybe we don't have to fight them.
Right, let's just call 'em names. Coach steps forward, poised to make the sale.
Ladies and gentlemen, if I may have your attention. The bar skeptically eyes the large, sweaty Greek man.

We have to think outside the box here. We don't need to fight them, we need to scare them. Scare them right back. This is a species stand- off. We just need to show them we're not vulnerable. That we're formidable.
How?
I need a stick. Bartender opens the cooler's lid and carefully pulls out Junior Beast with salad tongs. It falls to the floor with a SPLAT. Coach grabs a splintered broomstick.
Stand back. He buries the broomstick into Junior's side and carries the limp carcass towards a covered hole in the wall.
Let's get that board down. Roadie pries off a board to reveal a pumpkin sized hole.
What are you doing? Coach shoves Junior's mangled body through to the outside.

Showing superiority. The scent of their dead may drive them away. The whole bar moves to the side wall to see how the Beast family will react. They look through SMALL HOLES, barely able to see anything.
I don't see them.
Come on. Come onnnnnn.
Is there a call, or something?
See that you monkey fucks! That's what you get when you mess with us! Woman or man, I don't give a fuck! Shit don't make me gay because you'll be sucking my dick! Bozo's insult hangs in the air.

Sweet... P.O.V - THROUGH SMALL HOLES WHOOSH! Junior is swiped from the handmade pike. INT. BAR -- CONTINUOUS Coach jerks back. The startled group tries to focus, but it's too dark outside. With the moon as the only light, Father Beast can barely be made out cradling his dead child. Silhouettes of the other family members slowly approach Junior. Papa Beast is gentle and it's almost endearing.
It's working. I think it's working.

You see? What I tell you? The whole group starts to ease. Then... Papa Beast HOLLERS. P.O.V. - THROUGH SMALL HOLES Papa Beast lets out a HORRID WAIL. The group jumps back, covering their ears. Then, something really odd happens. Momma tosses Junior in the air, opens her wide jaws and SWALLOWS HIM WHOLE. INT. BAR -- CONTINUOUS Adulterer's eyes widen.
Good christ! They're cannibals!

Oh dear... P.O.V. - THROUGH SMALL HOLES Papa Beast moves behind Momma Beast and grabs hold of her. INT. BAR -- CONTINUOUS A steady "thud-thud-thud" rhythm vibrates the bar. Grandpa's drink starts to hop to edge of his table with the beats. The group maneuvers to get a better look.
Oh... my... god.
What are they doing now? P.O.V. - THROUGH SMALL HOLES Yes, Momma Beast and Papa Beast are having MONSTER SEX. INT. BAR -- CONTINUOUS

Dude, they're humpin'! P.O.V. - THROUGH SMALL HOLES Unlike humans, Papa Beast finishes and the birth cycle lasts all of thirty seconds. Momma Beast's belly balloons up and she squats. POP! A SLIMY OBJECT the size and shape of a vacuum cleaner drops from her. INT. BAR -- CONTINUOUS Trampy VOMITS. P.O.V. - THROUGH SMALL HOLES The slimy object SPLITS in half. The two halves spring appendages and raise their heads. The TWIN SISTER BEASTS have been born. Papa moves forward and cleans off his new baby girls. The Beast Girls look at the bar and hiss in unison. INT. BAR -- CONTINUOUS Heroine's eyes bulge.
Get back! SLAM-SLAM! The two hissing Beast Girls strike the bar front. Roadie shoves that board back over the hole. Beer Guy is holding back the still heaving Trampy's hair.
Any more ideas, Animal Planet?
I-I-I was just being proactive...
(to Bozo) Hey, you weren't helpin'!
Go douche.
What the hell now?
We're stuck in here. That's what. Bozo pops open a beer off the back of Para's wheelchair. Roadie nods to Grandpapa Beast's head on the end of the bar.
Hey, Miss? Heroine turns.
If you don't mind me asking, how did you run into these things?
More importantly, how did you run away from these things?

Well, it all started about forty hours ago... EXT. PRAIRIE LAND - The orange sun melts into the horizon. INT. FARMHOUSE -- CONTINUOUS Hero and his overweight friend TUBBS (35, hard living career farm hand) laugh at a TV show while Heroine paces on the telephone in the background.

(into phone) So, how is staying with Grandma working out? Ya know, if you stare into her glasses, you can see what cards she is holding. But I didn't tell you that. EXT. PRAIRIE LAND -- CONTINUOUS There's a home on the horizon with a big barn next to it. Shrieking and flapping grows in the distance. INT. FARMHOUSE -- CONTINUOUS Heroine starts to peek out of the window.
Mommy will pick you up tomorrow night, okay baby? The phone cuts out.
Hello? Charlie? Heroine and Hero look at each other with concern. Hero looks out the window.
Holy mother of... INT. BAR - Heroine has the group mesmerized.

We barricaded ourselves in the cellar. Then it was just listening. We heard those things destroy an entire heard of livestock. They just kept coming. Closer and closer, consuming anything in the way. Slashing, feeding and licking the bones clean. Just when we said our prayers, the first ray of sun hit the house... EXT. FARMHOUSE - PLOP! A HORSE'S HEAD falls as Heroine and her companions peek out from the damaged cellar door. INT. BAR -

That first beam of sunlight drove 'em away. Somewhere. We called who we could and then decided to run for it. We didn't see a soul the whole drive out. When the tank went dry, we came upon a gas station to refill. EXT. PRAIRIE LAND -- LATE DAY The sun is falling into the horizon. The traveler's CAMARO pulls into a small gas station EXT. GAS STATION -- CONTINUOUS Heroine goes up to the service window with Tubbs and looks inside. Nobody. There is a slight BUZZING from inside. Hero hollers from the fuel pump by the car.
What's goin' on? The pumps are off.
There's nobody here -- She follows the buzzing sound to a corner of the room. There is a swarm of black flies crawling over half a STATION ATTENDANT'S gutted torso.
They've been here!
Turn on the pump! Glass shatters as Heroine reaches inside to turn on the pumps. INT. BAR -
We had no time. All we knew was the sun was dropping and we had to get enough fuel to make it through the night at 90 miles per hour... EXT. GAS STATION -- LATE DAY Hero fills their Camaro.

Suck it down you metal bitch. Suck it down. INT. GAS STATION -- CONTINUOUS Heroine and Tubbs hastily grabs food and drinks, ignoring the cash register completely. The sun is setting. EXT. GAS STATION -- CONTINUOUS Hero turns as a shrill HISSING comes from the shadows... INT. BAR -
It happened fast... EXT. GAS STATION -- LATE DAY Heroine and Tubbs emerge from the gas station shop.
Move it! Heroine and Tubbs hear the growing cries of the Beasts. Their loot hits the pavement as they run.

Get in the car, baby. Hero drops the spilling gas nozzle. Tubbs slides into the back as Heroine jumps into the driver's seat. Hero runs over the top of the Camaro and slides into the sunroof. He grabs a rifle and aims toward the leaking gas pool. Something rises in the gas station. INT. BAR -
That's when I saw three others... just for a second. EXT. GAS STATION -- SUNSET Three lean, muscular shapes rise from the shadows.
Roll! Heroine fires up the car and tears out. Hero shoots and the station becomes a FIREBALL. INT. CAMARO -- CONTINUOUS
Close the roof! Hero lowers into the back seat and starts to close the roof as STRIPPED COUSIN BEAST lands on top of the car...

Shit! Stripped Cousin Beast PUNCHES through the back window, reaching for them. Heroine jerks the wheel. The car 180's and the Beast sails off of the car into darkness. The Camaro tears down a tangent dirt road.

We made it! Hero reaches back to give a "five" to Tubbs. Tubbs doesn't respond. Heroine is the first to see Tubbs' quivering, HEADLESS body in the back seat. INT. BAR - Heroine stands near Grandpa Beast's head.

It must have smelled the blood or something. We buried the body and got back on the main road when... INT. CAMARO - BOOM! Grandpa Beast LANDS on the front hood of the Camaro. Heroine and Hero SCREAM and rev the engine, swerving madly as Grandpa Beast VOMITS on the windshield.
Break! Heroine slams on the breaks. Grandpa Beast slides back, holding onto the grill.
Go! Go! Go! Grandpa Beast tears into the engine through the grill as sparks and smoke shoot out. Heroine jerks the steering wheel.
Look out! INT. BAR -
And that's how I ended up here.

And the head? INT. CAMARO - The car crashes into a ditch, DECAPITATING Grandpa Beast. His head FIRES through the windshield, landing on Heroine's lap. Its snake-like tongue lashes out at Heroine's crotch. INT. BAR -
I don't want to talk about that.
So, your husband ditched you?
No. It was wild out there. No time to think. We just moved. He didn't leave me. He just ran.
Well, justice is funny. Para wheels over to a COUNTY MAP on the side wall.
The three from the gas pump are over at the TV station? And you say there's four here, huh?
It appears so.
There's five here now, actually.
Yeah, thanks for that.
(to Heroine) Hey, you lived on a farm, right?
Yeah.
Do you think they're gone? I haven't heard anything for a while, maybe they're gone.
Well, maybe they migrate?
As long as it's dark, they're around. They hide, wait for you to drop your guard, and then attack.
How can you be so sure? You said yourself this started a day ago.
We learned fast.
We? We learned fast? You are all that is left of we. No offense Pocohantas, but I think someone else should play "Chief" tonight. Someone that knows the lay of the land. Like me.
Fine. Para stares intently at the map. Adulterer moves over to the window that has shutters over it, peeking through a hole.
Maybe these things are like locusts or something and only come out for a few days to feed. This could just be a part of their life cycle.
Somebody's gotta know something about these things. This stuff just doesn't happen out of the blue. The room is silent. Bozo looks around, quickly moving towards Grandpa and Grandma.
You!
Wha?
You gotta know somethin', you're old.
I don't know a thing.
Old people know stuff like this. Legends, tall tales, shit like that.
No!
Spill it!
I don't know anything!
(to Grandma) How 'bout you? Or do I have to get rough?
Heavens no!
Come on! Think back!
If I throw a stick, will you go away?
That's just horse shit.
Relax, they don't know anything.
Yeah... allegedly. Bozo saunters off.
(to Heroine) Hey, where was your farm?
(points to map) East. Why?
Did you ever slaughter? Slaughter livestock?
Previous owners did, I think.
What are you talking about?
Slaughterhouse run-off used to be drained into piping that ran through the mountains. Para points along the map as he explains.
Earthquakes often cracked the piping and those flow lines were condemned, but never drained.
Cheese n' rice...
I still don't get it.

What I am saying is... there's a distinct possibility that what we are up against is the result of steady stream of blood and tissue that has been leaking into the caves. And a day ago... something broke out. The group is silent.
The first order of business is gettin' a big fuckin' tampon in that cave!
Nope, that wouldn't do it. FROM ADULTERER'S P.O.V. - He peeks out the hole and sees nothing but the dark night. Bartender eyes him.
I wouldn't do that.
They're probably on to the next buffet by now. There's a retirement home up the road, they'd be easy pickings.
(to Adulterer) Careful.
I'm telling you, I don't see a thing -- BOINK! Papa Beast's claw POKES into his eye. Adulterer JERKS away holding his blood squirting eye socket.
P.O.V. - The eye sees its owner stumble back and fall to the floor holding his face.
Coach and Trampy move to help Adulterer.
The eyeball fires into Papa's drooling mega-mouth. SLURP!
BASH! A Beast arm BURSTS through the side wall and SNAGS Coach's pants and boxers. He screams and lunges forward. He is BOTTOMLESS.
Everyone stay in the middle of the room! Off the walls! NOW! Everyone obeys her command to get in the middle of the room. Belle hands Coach a little menu to cover himself with.
Now, does everyone agree that they are still out there? The group nods.
(to Bozo) 'Eh, Chief?
...Duh. Trampy holds Adulterer's wounded head.
He's out cold.
I know some first aid if we have a kit. Do we?
In the kitchen, under the sink.
No one goes anywhere alone. Least of all, unarmed.
(to Coach) There's some sweats in my bag behind the bar.
Thanks. Coach heads to the bar. Roadie moves to the map near Para.
You're a clever man. (re: Bozo) Why do you take shit from him?
Yeah, he's an ass, but he's my brother. Que sera-sera.
Your brother, huh?
Yep.
Same parents?
Look man, I read books. He reads bumper stickers. Roadie nods. Heroine jerks a bottle of booze from Beer Guy and tosses it out.

Alright, we need to stay alert and for everyone to take a role. (to Boss Man) You gotta have some guns or weapons around here. Boss Man, pale and morphine pumped, sits at a table with his foot raised.
I got my .38 here. That's six shots and two refills. Downstairs, I have locker with a sawed-off and some gardening tools. Maybe a few boxes of shells.
I got shells, too. Box and a half tops. Machete behind the bar.
Okay, well that's something.
So we've got guns, kitchen knives, pipes, fire and sticks. Beer Guy scans the stocked bar wall.
I might be able to do something with the bottles.
You're gonna need a whole lot more than that to get outta here alive. The crowd turns to face Grandpa and his wife.
Oh, now you have something to say? Grandpa holds on to Grandma's hand as he speaks.
You young'uns worry about weapons, I'm thinkin' 'bout strategy.
Oh? And what's that?
Sit still, look less like a meal.
That's for bears and sharks, chunky chew. The group looks back to Heroine.
Alright, what else do we have? Can we somehow contact the outside world? Trampy pensively stays on her fractured phone.
I can't get anybody. I don't even know if I have a signal anymore.
I have a CB in my truck, we could get some help out here.
Who the hell would you call?
Anyone.
Do you drive a short beer bus or something? You go out there, you get eaten. You stay in here, you get eaten. Anyone comes to help, they get eaten. Don't you see a pattern here, Spuds Makenzie?
Then I guess we should just give up.
(re: Trampy) Believe me, I'd love to save the day and get some heroic snatch, but it's not in the cards, partner.
(to Boss Man) You said you had a short wave radio.
Where?
Upstairs.
Go for it. It's by the far wall. Channel 9 is the emergency frequency.
Good. I'm heading to the basement for supplies. (to Bozo) And you're going upstairs. Bozo blinks. A little taken aback.
Let's not get carried away...
Step up, Chief.
So that's how it is? (hands out) Fine! Shotgun, please. Bartender hands him The Judge.
(to Bartender) You're coming with, portly. 'Cause if I'm attacked, I want a fat man close by.
I'll wait by the door.
Now who else is comin'? No one budges.
(rising from his seat) I'll go with ya.

What are you gonna do? Throw your teeth at 'em? Sit down, Cocoon. Bartender moves to the back of the bar, grabbing his machete. At the same moment, Coach emerges from behind the bar in very snug, feminine-looking pink sweat pants.
You! Zorba! You're coming too! (to Heroine) Now gimme the keys. Heroine tosses the keys to Bartender.
No. You're locked in.
What?
Those two will be on the other side waiting for you. If you become food, I don't want the only set of keys in the belly of one of those things.
Don't get your hopes up. Bozo moves to the staircase. There's blood at the bottom and it gets worse with each step. Bartender and Coach follow. Heroine turns to the bar.
Any volunteers to head into the basement with me?
I will. Tuffy stands, sniffling. She wipes the tears from her eyes, looking tough and resolute.
That's not a good idea.
With what happened upstairs --
Shut up! Shut your mouth. You have no idea what is running through me right now. No idea. (to Heroine) I'm ready.
Alright.
Count me in.
Me too. Heroine, Tuffy, Roadie, and Beer Guy all move to the basement. The door creaks open slowly. The group descends.
Bozo slightly slips on the blood. He grips the railing and pulls himself up the staircase like an old man.
Alright you two, I don't want to hear any of this, "oh, I dropped the key, wrong key, ain't no key here." When I want out, I want out, ok?
(displaying keys) They're right here.
We've got your back, bro. They unlock the door, swinging it open.
Just keep 'em handy, ladies. Bartender has the key in the thick dead bolt, ready to move.
Bozo hustles in. The door shuts and locks.
Wish me luck... WHAM! Bozo is on the ground.
BOZO (O.S.) I'm okay! I'm okay!
Bozo rises and nervously surveys the damaged floor.
Come on. Come on. Come on. Bozo jumps when he sees the gore and the bloody shoes from Cody's attack. The TV illuminates the room.
Geeezzzus. (moving gingerly) Okay, now. Easy steps. Easy breaths. Easy steps.
Belle kneels next to the Boss Man.
How are you holding up?
Well... He pulls a bottle out of his pocket and hands it to her.
What is this?
Morphine. My magic potion. I need a few drops. She puts a few drops on his out-stretched tongue.
You should try a little, it'll calm your nerves. Works like a charm.
No other time than now, right?
Wait, before you do that, help me move. There's a small room off the kitchen where I can lay down.
But --
It's much safer in there. Trust me.
The basement is dark, dingy and scattered with crap. Dried out ANIMAL CARCASSES hang from the ceiling on hooks. A WINDOW is open. Roadie slams it shut, eyeing the room, staring into the dark corners.
Stay on your toes everybody. Tuffy tightly grips her weapon, ready to fire. Heroine kneels next to a hatch door that emits a red glow.
What's this? Roadie jams a pipe into the little door, bracing it shut.
You don't need to know what that is. Beer Guy finds the dusty locker and opens it.
There's a sawed-off shotgun in here.
Bartender and Coach have their ears pressed to the door.
Come on, bro. Behind them, through a boarded window, something CRAWLS upward.
Bozo moves turtle slow.

Lamaze. Lamaze. Lamaze. He moves to the Boss Man's private room. He puts his hand out to open it. Trembling, he touches the knob and... CREEEEEEEEAK! The door eases open. Bozo steps inside the room. He moves over to a lamp and pulls the chain. A bat FLIES off the lamp shade SCREECHING. Bozo falls backwards.
Bartender and Coach jump back.
Bozo gets off the floor again. He may have filled his pants.
Just a bat! I'm okay! Just a bat!
If he doesn't shut up...
He is human kabob.
The room is like a converted pantry. Boss Man lies on a cot, kissing Belle. A tiny wall fan spins providing ventilation. Belle pulls away and brushes back her long hair.
Doesn't your foot hurt?
I can't feel a thing, Hon.
(touching his crotch) How 'bout now?
You're a bad girl, aren't you. Belle, a bit high, sways and starts to remove her clothes.
Um-hmmm.
The girl's got rhythm. She takes off her blouse and tosses it at him. She then lifts up her skirt and bends over, giggling.
There it is.
Roadie emerges with two crates. He dumps them on the floor.
This is all junk. Beer Guy holds a rusted machete.
This could come in handy.
Let's get everything upstairs. Heroine moves to the stairs, but stops. She grabs Tuffy by the arm and takes her aside.
I'm sorry.
Don't worry, I'm fine. Really.
I admire your strength.

Trust me, I plan on having a full breakdown when this is over, but for now, we all have to be strong, right? Heroine reaches into her shirt and pulls out an IDENTICAL LOCKET as Tuffy's. She opens it and displays a picture of a LITTLE GIRL.
This is my daughter, Charlie. She's all I'm after.
(fighting back tears) Oh...
And I'm gonna need your strength, every bit of it.
You have it.
Good. But still do me a favor.
Name it.
(with a wink) Don't tell anyone I have a soft side.
(tiny smile) Deal.
Bozo turns and points the gun around the room. He sees the CB. It is like an intercom with a cable running outside. He drops the shotgun and fidgets with the CB knobs.

Hello? Anyone there? We need help out here at the United Nations Tavern. Send guns, tanks, and all that shit. 10-4. S.O.S. All he gets is static. A faint GROWL is heard outside. OUTSIDE THE DOOR Bartender hears the growl, his eyes grow wide.
Belle rubs her hands over her rounded ass and flicks her tongue at Boss Man.
You wanna see, baby?
Hell yeah.
How much you got?
How much I got, what?
How much you got to see the show?
You don't understand, sweety. Daddy doesn't pay. Daddy sees the show for free. But you do get points for being horny on a night like this. She cringes and backs up a little.
What?
You can't expect a man to buy a car without a test drive first, can you?
Um, hmm --
Now wiggle that sweet little ass over here and sit on Daddy's face, I wanna do some appraising.
Bozo barks into the CB.
Repeat. We need help. SOS. Calling all cars! Calling all cars! We need help at the United Nations Tav -- The CB is JERKED from Bozo's hands and slams into the wall.
Shit! Bozo aims the gun at the wall. Chewing sounds begin.
Double shit! He backs up to the door.
BOZO (O.S.) Okay, I'm ready to come out now! Bartender confidently turns the key. CLICK! It breaks off in the lock.
Oh!
"OH!?" WHAT IS "OH?" What does "oh" mean? Bozo knocks on the door hard.
Bartender looks to Coach.
Wha?
A thunderous CRASH! Boards fly off the wall.
Belle, hearing the crash, jerks back from Boss Man.

What was that? CRASH! Sister Beast #1 and Sister Beast #2 punch through the tiny wall fan and GRAB Belle by the scalp. She is JERKED against the wall. She's slammed against it repeatedly and then -- RIP! Belle's skin is TORN from her head and torso. Boss Man jumps back.
Hoh-SHIT! Help! Help me! Belle falls into Boss Man's arms for a HIDEOUS KISS.
Boss Man shoves the bloody Belle back against the wall. Sister Beast #1 pokes her head inside the room, hissing.
Heroine and the others, just returning from the basement, hear the mayhem from upstairs and the kitchen.
Coach fumbles desperately with the jammed lock, trying to use his fingernails to turn the metal stump.
Great god, why do you damn me?!
Bozo bangs on the door and looks over his shoulder at the Momma and Papa Beast chomping at the wall.
The group is mesmerized.
Oh please, no.
Boss Man uses the cot to block the Sister Beasts from entering. They hiss and shred the cot fabric.
They're getting in! Somebody help!
Bozo kicks and punches the door.
Heroine charges up the staircase. Roadie rips the sawed-off weapon from Beer Guy and runs for the kitchen.
The key broke off!
(to Coach) Move it! Heroine rips the earring from Bartender's ear. He YELPS. She jams the backing into the lock.
Boss Man crawls for the door. Sister Beast #1 fires out a whip-like tongue and snags Boss Man's damaged foot. He howls in pain. Sister Beast #2 tongue-lasso's his other foot.
Heroine's picking fingers are bleeding from her effort. BOZO (O.S.)
Boss Man is pulled towards the Sister Beasts.
Roadie kicks open the door and FIRES at the Sisters. They dive back out of the room screeching.

Right behind Bozo, the boards fly off the portal window. Papa Beast flies at Bozo. Bozo spins and aimlessly FIRES his shotgun, hitting Papa Beast directly in the groin. The door flies open. Bozo is YANKED to safety just as Papa STRIKES the closing door.

The patrons track the wild CRASHING and HIGH-PITCHED SHRIEKING sounds of Papa Beast. He finally breaks out of the upstairs. Beer Guy and Roadie carry Boss Man into the room as Coach, Bartender, Heroine and the shaken Bozo creep down the stairs. Bozo slowly takes a seat in his brother's lap.
I thought that was it for a second there.
What happened?
I got Papa in the stones. He's neutered.
Whoa... good one...
That back room is sealed shut. Heroine glares at Boss Man.
I told you to stay in the main room.
Yeah... I will. I will. Promise. Coach eyes the group, this is his time to shine.

(rising, full of brawn) If they can't reproduce anymore -- we are one step closer! A big step! Now is the time to band together. We need to rise up against these monsters of the night! Those creatures are no match for the human spirit! We can do it! We just need to believe in each other! In all of us! We need to make a stand! Right here! Right now! Long silence. Bozo stares.
Dude, are you gay? Coach sits down, humbled.
We know what not to do. We must stay focused and together. The beasts will find a breach. We gotta find a way out before they find a way in.
Let's run for the cars, cause mass confusion.
The lot's too damn far, that's surefire suicide. The room is silent. Bartender motions to Boss Man, but he is promptly shushed by Boss Man. Heroine notices.
(to Boss Man) What?
What?
You know what.
I don't know shit.
(to Roadie) You. What was that door downstairs?
Wait, wait, wait. Heroine glares at Roadie.
Don't bullshit me.
It's a tunnel. Roadie nods, causing Boss Man to sigh.
It runs about a hundred yards and spits out on the backside of that hill down the way.
What's it for? They clam up.
What's it for!?
Grass, man. I grow pot down there.
Does the tunnel spit out near a car?
It spits out behind the parking lot.
My truck is near, but it ain't nearly big enough to haul the whole lot.
It's a shot. Is it gassed up?
Fully.
Four door?
Two.
How many can it hold?
Six.
Max?
Seven.
It's gonna fit thirteen.
Thirteen clowns wouldn't fit.
(with hand out) Keys.
What're you planning?
Three of us go. Two to defend, one to drive. We back up to the bar and then tear ass out of here.
Sounds sketchy.
Let me make this clear; if we stay, we die. Boss Man reluctantly pulls out some keys that are on a string around his neck.
Give 'em to me, I'm going.
You're trusting that con? He'll ditch us and never look back.
Fuck you too.
Get in line!
Hey! I'm not trusting him either, that's why I'm going with. Coach stands forward.
"Courage is being scared to death, but saddling up anyway." (off blank stares) The Duke. I will go.
This is it. They have this place surrounded, but if we go under them we might just make it.
This is a bottleneck waiting to happen. SMACK! Bozo SLAPS Coach's ass.
This one's great under pressure. I wish you luck.
The rest of you prepare the weapons, whatever you got left. 'Cause when we crash through those walls, we're bringin' death with us. Heroine takes The Judge from Bartender and hands it to Coach.
No, I don't believe in guns.
This ain't time for a political stance. Coach takes the rusty machete from Beer Guy.
This doesn't run out of ammo.
Got ya. Heroine, Roadie, and Coach move to the basement.
Hey! The three look to Bozo, who offers a parting nod.
When you get to that truck... drive it like you stole it. INT. BAR -- CONTINUOUS At a booth, Trampy re-bandages Adulterer's eye.
How does it feel?
Lousy.
You still have one left.
Yes, the silver lining.
It serves you right for cheating.
Spare me.
I figure it's karma. You wronged me and you wronged your wife, so this is karma biting you on the ass, or in your case... in the eye. Bozo moves close, surveying the bandage work.
Oh yeah?
It could be worse, you could be dead. Then again, the climax is upon us.
(re: Trampy's hair) Ya know, that's not a bad look on you. Kinda 1985, but not bad. I'd hook it up.
I wouldn't fuck you for practice.
Tease.
Leave her alone.
Hey, cyclops. Let's have a quiet contest... starting now. Bozo turns his attention back to Trampy.

Ya know, in situations of duress, I have found that women are attracted to my authority. INT. BAR -- BASEMENT -- CONTINUOUS Heroine, Roadie, and Coach make their way through the basement. Creeks and cracks with every step.
(to Heroine) You handle yourself pretty well. You a cop or a criminal?
Neither. Just a farmer.
Oh yeah? Then how do you do it?
I just think about my husband and daughter... and the rest is easy. The light casts a shadow of something BEHIND THE CURTAIN. Roadie moves to open the curtain with his sawed-off barrel.
Easy. WHIP! The curtain slides. It's a dried animal hide on a hook. They all sigh. Roadie unblocks the tiny door. Heroine scans the room.
This place is creepy in the daytime, too. Ready? Coach's hand shakes as he raises his weapon.
Scared?
No. You?
Of course not. I fight monsters all the time. (gripping the door) On three. Roadie, Heroine raise their weapons.
One... two... three! Roadie whips open the door. Nothing. BANG-GONG-GONG! Some pipes CRASH to the ground next to them... they jump, but nothing is there. A LITTLE MOUSE emerges from the fallen heap.
Well, look at that. Coach leans down and puts out his hand. He smiles as Heroine watches over his shoulder.
Hey, little fella.

Let's go. He leaves the mouse and follows Heroine to the tunnel. SLURP! A pink tongue LASSOS the mouse. A red fluorescent glow radiates from the tunnel. They all drop in, one by one, entering the steamy, confined space.
Looks like a brothel for plants.
Shhhhhhhhhhhhh. INT. BAR - Tuffy stands by a far wall, looking through the planks for movement. At the bar, Beer Guy makes MOLOTOV COCKTAILS. Bozo moves close, slaps Beer Guy's constructing hand.
Ah-ah-ah! You're doing that all wrong!
What do you know?
I know you're doing it wrong.
Prove it. Bozo grabs a cloth rag and moves to the alcohol bottles.

Move aside, princess. INT. TUNNEL - The tunnel is thin and no more than SIX FEET HIGH. Cherry red fluorescent lights line the top of the tunnel and kneehigh marijuana plants are along the ground soil. There are thick pipes above the plants that work as a makeshift watering system. There is about six inches of water on the floor.
(to Roadie) You and I are similar. We both have accents. We both travel a lot. We both don't really have homes...
You should be quiet.
I am sorry, I ramble when I'm nervous.
Quiet. Coach bites his lip, dying to say something.
It's just that this seems like the opportune time for someone to be horribly... offed.
What did I say?
Sorry. I'm done now. INT. BAR - Bozo stuffs the cloth rag into one of the bottles.
You don't want the rag touching booze, that way you can hold it and ensure it explodes when you throw it.
You sure? I thought the rag had to touch?
I'm sure. Bozo finishes the Molotov cocktail and grabs a beer.

Perfecto. What we should do, though, is put those peanut barrels to use. Fill 'em with booze and line up some planks. If the walls come down... we hit 'em Donkey Kong style. Para and Beer Guy eye the three large peanut barrels, perfect for bomb-making.
Genius.
You aren't nearly as dumb as you look, are you?
Next time, look within. Stereotyping can be ugly and hurtful. Bozo looks to Trampy, putting an arm around her shoulder.
Excuse me for being forward, but I'm curious about your dimensions. INT. TUNNEL - Roadie leads the way and glares at the opposite end. The tunnel slightly curves, so he can't see the whole way down.
Hold up. You hear something? A SCRATCHING sound is heard from above.
They're trying to burrow through the tunnel walls.
Move. The scratching sound increases, now heard from the far end of the tunnel as well.
Like moles these things. Then, Sister Beast #1 drops into the tunnel from the far end. She charges. At the last second, Roadie spots her.

Duck! Roadie and Coach duck into the water, but Heroine is unable to avoid a thrust that knocks her back ten yards. Sister Beast #1 lands and turns, surveying her prey. Roadie aims his water-dripping gun, but Heroine rises and blocks his shot.
Stay down! From her knees, Heroine fires. BLAM-BLAM-BLAM! The three shots push Sister Beast #1 backwards. Heroine rises, covered in muddy water and bleeding from a cut across the face.

Go! The bitch is mine! Roadie and Coach reluctantly turn, leaving Heroine to fend with the Beast. Heroine charges. Hissing, Sister Beast #1 charges as well. Heroine pumps and fires. BOOM! Sister Beast spins, avoiding the shot. Now too close, Heroine jams the Beast in the mouth with the gun, knocking her back. Sister Beast #1 responds with a swipe and chomp on the arm. Heroine bats her away. Sister Beast #1 moves to the others.
Look out! Roadie and Coach sprint until Sister Beast #2 BURSTS through the tunnel walls, stopping Roadie and Coach in their tracks. Roadie fires his weapon, but it sparks and fizzles.
The shells are wet! With the two Beasts closing in. The men are trapped. Coach looks around, seeing a plan.
Grab onto ceiling and get out of water!
What?
Do it! Grabbing onto the piping along the ceiling, Roadie pulls himself from the water. Coach uses the machete to cut a power cord from above. He grabs the exposed, sparking end.

(to Heroine) Get out of water! Heroine sees what he's doing, sprints back the way they came. As the two Beasts charge, Coach pulls himself out of the water by holding onto the above piping. He's forced to wait for Heroine to get out of the water. The second she does, he jams the cord into the water. ZAP! The conductive water sizzles. Sister Beast #1 and Sister Beast #2 lock up and crash. ELECTROCUTION. Sparks and smoke rises from their cooked bodies. Roadie and Coach look to each other, victorious. They begin shimmying along the piping to the end of the tunnel. INT. TUNNEL/BASEMENT - Heroine looks back at the two men. She turns and reenters the basement. GAH! Teen Beast drops in front of her, whacking her to the floor. Heroine slides across the floor, but jumps up quickly. Teen Beast cautiously moves in for the kill. Heroine raises her weapon.
You fuck with my family. (aiming shotgun) I fuck right back! Click -- out of ammo!

Oh shit. Heroine THROWS the shotgun at him and pulls out the MACHETE. She rolls left and swings. Teen Beast loses two fingers. She swings again but gets whacked to the floor. Heroine rolls with the hit, grabs her shotgun, and dives into the KEG ELEVATOR. She slams closed the door as Teen Beast regains its composure and lunges. BAM! It CRASHES against the door. INT. TUNNEL - Roadie and Coach crawl to the platform by the exit.
They will write stories of your bravery.
If there's anybody left. The two men climb up the ladder leading to the ground above. At the top, Roadie pushes off the plywood covering. The two men peer into the night and spot the TRUCK.
Heroine wedges the door closed. The Beast continues to try to get in. Heroine bangs the top of the small elevator...
Send it up! Send it up!
Tuffy backs up and hears the screams from the keg elevator.
Hey! Hey! She's in the shaft! Beer Guy hits the button. The gears grind and start to pull the elevator up to the main floor.
Heroine squirms as the elevator rises.
Move it! Move it! Move it! As Teen Beast starts to tear at the base of the rising keg elevator in the shaft, Heroine pounds and tears at the few planks above her in the keg elevator.
Beer Guy hits the button.
Come on!
Ol' Crazy Horse has seen it.
Shut up!

The elevator SHAKES. Heroine POUNDS a hole through the elevator top. She tries to squeeze through the SMALL HOLE. Teen Beast BITES through the floor board of the keg elevator. CLANGGG! The elevator stops. Heroine lurches and grabs the greasy cables to stop her fall.
Goddamn it!
It stopped. It fuckin' stopped!
Heroine screams as the elevator shakes. Teen Beast is struggling to climb right under her.
Do something!
Tuffy moves for the keg door. Adulterer grabs The Judge from Bartender.
Stop!
What the fuck are you doing?!
They can't get in here! We agreed! They'll get us!
She can make it!
I will not die because of her!
Don't be stupid, drop the gun!
Heroine HACKS at one of the two greasy cables. Teen Beast is in the elevator car and RISING.
They'll get in! We'll all die!

Heroine almost has the primary cable cut. Teen Beast rises up to bite. SNAP! The cable BREAKS. Heroine SOARS up the shaft. Teen Beast is pulled down to the bottom. The keg elevator door bursts open on impact. Heroine SLAMS into the ceiling, kicking and yelling.

Tuffy KNOCKS Adulterer's shotgun up, takes the gun, and rips open the keg door. Heroine swings out. P.O.V. - Teen Beast is right behind her with mouth open and ready to feed. Tuffy points her shotgun. BLAM! Teen lurches back, dropping back down the shaft. Tuffy slams the keg door shut. Heroine pants on the floor. Adulterer is down, winded.
Welcome back.
F-f-fuck you.
What the hell happened?
You okay?
I think they made it. She turns to Adulterer, rigid.

Stop trying to get people killed. It is getting very old. Adulterer nods, ashamed. Heroine looks around the bar. She notices the peanut barrels on top of the bar. Two wooden planks serve as track, leading straight for the side wall.
What's this?
Ingenuity, baby. Ingenuity.
(to Bartender) I need some shells.
I have two left. Bartender expels a shell from The Judge and hands it over.
Make it count. Heroine cringes, eyeing the lined up Molotov cocktails.
Let's prepare ourselves, they ought to be here with the truck any minute.
Bullshit. Boss Man sips a bottle, still hopped-up on morphine. He lazily loads his pistol from a pool of bullets on his belly.
If you ask me, I'm gonna just lay right here, wait for sunrise, then walk on out of here.
That's your choice, but this is going to get a whole lot worse before it gets any better. Boss Man shrugs, content with himself.

If all of you run for it, they won't care about lil ol' me. They like the food that moves... CRASH! Teen Beast's arm ERUPTS through the Boss Man's belly. His pistol and bullets scatter across the floor.
SNAPPP! His head and legs SLAP together as the arm pulls him through a small hole in the floor. The group jumps back. Blood rockets out. His body is pureed down the tiny hole.

Get on the tables! On the tables! Everyone struggles to get on the tables. CRASH! Teen Beast's arm reaches up and GRABS Para's wheelchair, violently shaking it. Para FALLS to the floor. Teen Beast's arm grabs Para's leg...
Bonsai! Bozo jumps from a table and STOMPS on Teen Beast's arm. He picks up Para and TOSSES him onto a table.
Hot potato! Bozo leaps back onto a table. POP! The power cuts out. The room goes black.
We're gonna die!
What the hell?!
Settle down!

Stop it! Stop it! Stop it! And with that, the shouting and pounding stops. The group nervously shuffles around the tables. There's silence. Dead silence. Then, far is the distance, beyond the walls, a sound is heard. It's screaming. And it's approaching. Rapidly. The survivors maneuver to peek out the front walls.
What's that? Tuffy sees what is coming.
They didn't make it. EXT. BAR -- CONTINUOUS Being held by Papa and Momma Beast, Roadie and Coach are both rushed towards the wall like human battering rams.

THUD! The first strike causes the men to HOWL. INT. BAR -- CONTINUOUS The survivors shake in sickened silence. From beyond the walls, they can hear high-pitched SCREAMS. THUD! THUD! THUD! With every strike, a splattering of blood spits through the planks of wood.
That wall's coming down!
Commence Plan B! The entire group goes into motion.
What's Plan B?
Just watch the floor and keep the others safe! THUD! THUD! THUD! With a final furious strike, a few wood planks splinter. Papa Beast sticks in his head and hisses.

Bomb's away! From the bar, Beer Guy, Tuffy, and Adulterer release the first peanut barrel. It's ablaze and sails straight for Papa Beast. BLAM! It explodes, bursting open the wall and knocking back Papa Beast. The wooden walls go up in flame. Para, on a side table, reaches out and grabs Boss Man's .38 from the floor. The second peanut barrel is released. It sails outside the breach, but it doesn't explode. Nevertheless, the Beasts stay far away. Teen Beast madly rips floor boards away, moving towards Para's table. Teen Beast bursts through the floor, knocking Para to the floor. Para crawls to his fallen wheelchair. Teen Beast spots him, moves in to feed. Para points his seat back at the scattered .38 bullets and flips the armrest switch. SNAP! The bullets jump to the power magnet. Para yanks one free, loads the pistol and turns just as Teen Beast strikes... POP! The shot hits Teen Beast in the eye, sending him back down the hole in the floor. Heroine and Bartender move in. When Teen Beast sticks his head out of the hole again, they thrust both their shotguns into each ear.

Now! BLAM-BLAM! The two shots scatter head everywhere. The flames in the bar spread, catching the entire wall and roof on fire. EXT. BAR -- MOMENTS LATER The second barrel comes to a stop a good distance from the bar. Suddenly, the top is knocked off. Trampy sticks her head out. Seeing no trouble, she emerges, dizzy as hell, and races for the nearby BEER TRUCK. INT. BAR -- MOMENTS LATER Papa and Momma Beast both charge the bar. The third peanut barrel is released. It sails for them, but they dive out of the way. KABLOOM! It takes out the rest of the wall. Fire and smoke fills the place. Adulterer douses Momma Beast with booze as Beer Guy nails her with a lit Molotov cocktail. WHOOSH! Engulfed in flame, she bolts from the bar shrieking.
One down, one to go! Papa enters and is instantly cornered. He swings wildly.
(to Bartender) Help me! Heroine and Bartender rip the DEER HEAD from the wall and charge Papa, pinning him against the wall with the antlers.

Come on! Bozo and Beer Guy dive into Papa's legs, holding them down. Tuffy picks up The Judge. WHAM! The shotgun butt knocks out Papa's front teeth. Tuffy raises the weapon again, staring down at the monster that killed her child, but Papa Beast gets an arm free to knock away her fatal blow. Bartender wrenches Papa Beast's arm with all his might. With her hair stuck in Papa Beast's claw, Tuffy is pulled face to face with the beast. She squirms as he chomps at her, but with no front teeth, he can't do immediate damage.
I can't hold him!

Do something! Tuffy reaches back and shoves her fist into Papa Beast's mouth, jamming it down his throat. He instantly gags, sucking for air. Papa Beast struggles to get free, but the others hold tight. Papa Beast's body begins to quiver from a lack of oxygen. His eyes widen, face to face with Tuffy.
With one last lunge, Papa Beast shakes, his life drifting away. His eyes turn black as his body goes limp. Tuffy pulls out her arm from his throat.
God...

I need to get your number. Tuffy shakes her wet arm dry. As the group pulls away, Papa Beast is still pinned to the wall with the deer antlers dug into the wood. Heroine turns to Grandma and Grandpa, offering a hand.
Come on, I'll help you.
No thank you, we're content.
I'm not leaving anyone behind.

Maybe next time, dear. Heroine swallows and nods. HONK-HONK-HONK! Just outside the breached wall, the beer truck pulls up. EXT. BAR -- CONTINUOUS The beer truck screeches to a halt. Trampy's at the wheel, waving the group over. With the bar burning, a thick layer of SMOKE blankets the entire area. The people amass at the opening, but Heroine stops them from advancing. The group stares the dark night. Silent.
She's still out here. Heroine eyes the truck, seeing something she likes.
Stay put. She creeps out alone.
Where are you... come on... Nothing. Just smoke. And silence.

Come on! Come on! From the smoke, a smoldering Momma Beast charges like a bull. At the truck, Heroine opens the back doors and dives in, leaving the doors open. Momma Beast gives chase, entering the back.
Heroine is deep into the truck as Momma Beast enters. She advances, hissing.
Come and get me you blood-chugging
Momma howls and charges. Heroine slides out the side keg door, locking it behind her. Before Momma can see the trap, Beer Guy slam closed the rear doors.
Beer Guy latches it. Trampy comes around the truck.
You got her? You got her!
Not for long, we gotta burn it. Heroine looks to the others at the breach.

Come on! Let's blow this thing! The others move into action. Beer Guy takes off his shirt and shoves it into the fuel tank. Adulterer and Bozo, with Para riding piggyback, help. They use the Molotov cocktails to make a fuel trail leading away from the truck.
When this lights, run like hell. About fifteen yards away from the truck. Bozo throws his silver-plated American Eagle lighter to Heroine.
(catching lighter) Here we go... Then, a noise: EOCH-OCK-OCK! EOCK-OCK-OCK! EOCK-OCK-OCK! A deafening pattern of sound erupts from within the truck. It's Momma Beast. Again and again.
What is that?
She's calling for help. Heroine drops the lighter onto the fuel. It races for the truck. When feet away, COUSIN BEAST lands, stomping out the fire with his foot.

The fan has officially been buried in the shit. Instantly, another beast, AUNT BEAST, lands on the top of the truck. These Beasts are like the others, but stripped. The group gasps. Trampy backs away.

We have to run -- BURST! Trampy's rib cage is ripped from her body. The culprit, UNCLE BEAST, stands behind her. Her organs drop like a box of vegetables. Cousin Beast lets out a high-pitched roar. From atop the truck, the rear doors are ripped open. Momma Beast emerges.
Get to your cars! The Beasts spring into action, chasing the group. Bozo, with Para on his back, sprints for his car. Aunt Beast RIPS Para from Bozo's back.
Motherfucker! Give him back! Bozo runs for his Trans-Am. Para falls to the ground, still alive. Bozo turns back and sees him.
Oh Jesus!
Bozo grabs his brother and puts him on his back again, runs.
I thought we lost you -- Para is RIPPED into the air again.
You FUCKER! Tuffy and Bartender jump into his PICKUP TRUCK.
(to Heroine) Get in! Heroine hops in the back. Beer Guy and Adulterer run to a car together. Beer Guy lags behind, continually looking over his shoulder.
Run and quit looking back! As Beer Guy looks forward, Aunt Beast and Uncle Beast hit him HIGH-AND-LOW, cutting him in half. Bozo makes it to his Trans-Am.
VAHVVVOOOMMMM! The car roars to life. He pushes in a tape. The "MIAMI VICE" theme song blares from the speakers.
Get me FUCK BIRDS! Bozo peels out. Aunt Beast lands right in his path.
No you don't! BAM! He SMACKS Aunt Beast head on, sending the creature's disemboweled body sailing through the air.
Para DROPS from the sky, still ALIVE and panting. Cars are moving everywhere.
Oh Jesussss... INT. BAR -- CONTINUOUS The burning JUKEBOX plays a slow love song. Dancing and holding each other, Grandpa smooches Grandma on the forehead.
We had a good run. EXT. BAR -- CONTINUOUS Para crawls along the ground, being ignored by the Beasts.
Bozo turns on his windshield wipers to clear off the blood and guts. He spots Para.
Hang on! Para claws the ground.
Hurry! Hurry! Hurry! Bartender jerks the wheel of his car.
Oh shit! Para sees Bartender's approaching truck.
Para rolls right, just missing tires. Para yells for his brother.
Bozo's eyes bulge.
Brother! BAM! Para is SMEARED by Adulterer's car.
Shit! Bozo floors it.

(overly endearing) I meant to tell you so much! The remaining cars maneuver to hit the open road. INT. BAR -- CONTINUOUS Grandpa and Grandma hold each other tight. Uncle Beast enters, moving to their table. It moves in for the kill. Grandpa kisses his wife gently.
Close your eyes, hon. The Beast OPENS its massive jaws and... CRASH! Bozo's car DRIVES through the bar, SMEARING the Beast. INT. BOZO'S CAR -- CONTINUOUS
Bozo guns the engine, crashing out the other end of the bar. EXT. BAR -- CONTINUOUS Bozo's car veers, flipping over a pile of rubble.

Motherfucker! Bozo squirms in his flipped car, UPSIDE-DOWN. He hears a Beast approaching. He pulls out a BUTTERFLY KNIFE from the open glove box and SAWS at his safety belt. Cousin Beast leans into the passenger side of the car and looks him right in the eye. Bozo raises the knife.

Lord, if I die, bury me upside down so the world can KISS MY ASS! Cousin Beast leaps in. EXT. BAR -- CONTINUOUS The remaining TWO CARS race down the road. INT. BARTENDER'S CAR -- CONTINUOUS With the peddle to the floor, Bartender drives.

I think we're in the clear -- BAM! Momma Beast lands on the roof. She reaches inside and yanks out Bartender's throat. The car veers. Tuffy rights it, leaning over and stomping on the gas. Momma yanks at the door, pulling it open. Tuffy pushes out Bartender's corpse and JERKS the wheel.

Momma Beast falls back, knocking down Heroine. Momma Beast nearly falls out, but manages to grab the rear gate with one claw. Defenseless, Heroine backs away. Momma Beast holds on tightly, pulling herself onto the bed of the truck. Tuffy stares back through the glass, unable to do anything. Momma Beast lunges towards Heroine. Momma Beast's claw snags Heroine's locket, jerking Heroine right up to the creature's face. The locket catches Momma's attention for split second. Her remaining eye goes from the picture of Charlie to Heroine. Momma's mouth opens wide. Heroine screams! And then, a beam of the RISING SUN catches the gold locket and burns into Momma's eye. In one quick motion, she's gone, taking the locket with her. Heroine lets out her breath, reaching around her neck for what is no longer there. The truck SKIDS to a halt. Tuffy jumps out.
Are you okay?!
I don't know, I think -- ADULTERER (O.S.) Hey! They both jump as Adulterer approaches.
Are you two all right? They left! We made it! I think we made it!
They'll be back.
We're safe until dark, but we need to find other people. Heroine rises and moves to the cab of the truck. She finds a pack of cigs under the visor. Pops in the lighter.
You know where the IGA grocery store is over in Red Mountain?
Um, yeah, ten miles west.
They have a bomb shelter. PING! The lighter springs out, hot. Heroine lights up and passes one to Tuffy.
We'll meet in three hours?
I don't wanna go home alone... I don't wanna see what might have...
Don't worry about that. Just go. Moment of silence as Adulterer and Tuffy look down the desolate road.
I'm sorry about your son. I really am. Tuffy nods, affectionately touching his hand.
Where are you two going?
We're going to get my little girl.

I wish you luck. The car peels off. Adulterer watches the car tear down the road. He glances up at the RISING SUN. EXT. TOWN ROAD - A sign reading "RED MOUNTAIN" swings lazily in the breeze. Tuffy and Heroine coast down a town road. There are random POOLS OF RED BLOOD in the dirt. No one in sight. EXT. TOWN ROAD - Adulterer drives along a small town road. There's no sign of life here either. EXT. HEROINE'S GRANDMOTHER'S HOUSE - The car pulls up to the house. The only sound is the wind. INT. BARTENDER'S CAR -- CONTINUOUS Heroine and Tuffy look at each other and proceed with caution. INT. ADULTERER'S CAR - He pulls up in front of his house. The front door is swinging open, BANGING against the door frame. INT. HEROINE'S GRANDMOTHER'S HOUSE - Heroine enters the ransacked house. Tuffy follows. INT. ADULTERER'S HOUSE - He enters his house. It too, is a mess. INT. HEROINE'S GRANDMOTHER'S HOUSE - They look down the stairs to the basement. Nothing. They move up the stairs to the second floor.

SMACK! They spin to the noise. INT. ADULTERER'S HOUSE - He moves up the stairs to the master bedroom. SMACK! There's a noise at the end of the hall. SMACK! INT. HEROINE'S GRANDMOTHER'S HOUSE - They cautiously move to the last room in the hall. A scratched, closed door without an outside handle.
Oh no... Heroine kicks in the door and... There's a note on a teddy beer that says, "WE WENT TO THE SHELTER. LOVE GRANDMA AND CHARLIE."
They're alive! The shudders SMACK against the wall. INT. ADULTERER'S HOUSE - Adulterer holds a shattered PICTURE of his wife and two kids. He sighs and puts it down.

I'm sorry... I'm so sorry... EXT. IGA (GROCERY STORE) - The sun shines bright in the cloudless sky. There is a stiff wind that stirs up the dust. Bartender's car slowly lurches up the street. INT. BARTENDER'S CAR -- CONTINUOUS Heroine and Tuffy skeptically look at the surroundings.

It's right up there, in the back of the store. EXT. IGA (GROCERY STORE) -- CONTINUOUS The car pulls up in the back of the store and stops. They get out, looking around. Tuffy holds a machete. Adulterer kneels against his car.
Where is everyone?
I don't know, I just got here. Did you find your girl?
She's supposed to already be here.
Your family? Adulterer shakes his head, acknowledging their death.
I'm sorry. Adulterer sheepishly nods.
This place is a ghost town. The group makes their way to the store front, peeking beyond the glass doors.
(pointing) Look! In the distance, in middle of a dusty parking lot, CHARLIE stands staring at them.
Charlie? Heroine runs to her and the others follow. Charlie fidgets awkwardly. She cries and blood stains her dress.
Charlie! As Heroine nears, Adulterer GRABS her arm.
Stop! There's something wrong!
Honey!? The group eyes Charlie, noticing Heroine's locket around her ankle, leading to a slightly ajar manhole cover. Suddenly, the sunlight starts to FADE. They look up the sun.
Oh god. The MOON moves in front of it -- a SOLAR ECLIPSE. Beast HISSING and FLUTTERING is heard. Heroine looks from left to right, panic stricken.
Mommy! The sunlight is fading. The manhole cover shakes, something is holding Charlie in place. Heroine lurches forward, but Adulterer holds her at bay.

It's a trap! At a standstill, the group looks around for options. In the distance, the darkness of the eclipse rolls towards them. Adulterer reacts, grabbing Tuffy's machete and lunging for Charlie. The strike cuts the chain at her ankle. The manhole cover POPS off and a Beast claw sinks into Adulterer. The darkness covers the manhole. Momma Beast rises, hoisting Adulterer's blood dripping body from the ground.

(gurgling blood) Run! Heroine scoops up her child, moving away from Momma Beast. Tuffy grabs them both, leading them back towards the store front. As Adulterer's blood flows, Momma Beast drags him towards her main prey. A blanket of darkness leads Momma Beast, overtaking the survivors. At the store front, Heroine pulls Charlie close.

(a whisper) I love you... CUT TO BLACK: EXT. IGA (GROCERY STORE) -- AN HOUR LATER A string of ten WHITE VANS come to a halt in the dusty parking lot. THE MAN IN TAN (45, buzz cut, leathery skin, cool) steps from the lead van and surveys the ravaged small town. A swarm of men emerge from the other vehicles, all dressed alike in work boots, gas masks and coveralls. They go into action honing in on rubble with SENSORS and COUNTERS.
What's the damage radius? TECH (27, horn-rimmed glasses, all business) eyes a laptop.
Twenty miles. Red Mountain, surrounding farms, local TV studio.
How many picked up the broadcast?
We'll have figures within the hour. The Man in Tan closes his eyes in thought.
Sir, what's the spin?
Tornado cluster.
This is the California high desert.

Get what you need to sell it. COMPANY MAN (O.S.) Sir, we have movement! The Man in Tan moves to a few men standing over a pool of blood and guts. Using the sensor equipment, the COMPANY MAN follows the blood trail that enters the grocery store. INT. IGA (GROCERY STORE) -- CONTINUOUS The place is torn to hell. Dust and soot hangs in the air. The men instinctively raise their high-powered rifles, letting the flashlights on the ends lead the way. They follow the trail of blood to a back FREEZER LOCKER. It's scratched, bashed and thrashed.

Open it. Company Man #2 steps forward and uses a metal-cutting chainsaw to cut through the hinges. The door falls with a THUD. As the dust clears, Tuffy, Heroine and Charlie stare back at the men, huddled together in a defensive stance. The Man in Tan creaks his neck.
Gentlemen, help them to safety. Heroine, holding Charlie, lurches back.
You're not safe, she's still alive, she'll be back...

Relax. We know. We're the calvary. The Man in Tan steps forward, guiding the group out. EXT. IGA (GROCERY STORE) -- MOMENTS LATER A bulky security truck pulls up. A DRIVER, holding a bloody rag to his nose, gets out and moves to the back door.
What happened to you? The Driver nods to the back of the truck, opening the door. Bozo lurches out, handcuffed and chained.
Get these cuffs off me! I'm a goddamn hero for Christ's sake! A shirtless, irate BOZO sits next to Grandpa and Grandma in the back. He settles at the sight of the others.
G'morning.
Thanks for waitin' for me back there, really fuckin' appreciate it! Heroine covers her daughter's ears as the survivors are helped into the truck. Tuffy sits, looking to Bozo.
How'd you survive?
I found a new weak spot on 'em, but it damn ain't pretty getting to it. Heroine, last in the truck, turns to the men.
Where are you taking us?
A trauma center. We have doctors waiting. You're in good hands now. The door shuts on Heroine's concerned face. The Man in Tan locks eyes with the Driver.

Do it quick and spread the mess. The Driver nods back. Sinister implication understood. The Man in Tan lights a cigarette as he watches the truck drive off. The truck's logo reads, "FARM-AID." He inhales. Freeze on him.

               College Boy and Lanky steer a cart loaded with the first 
               barrel inside. Chief's lone beam of light leads the men.

                                     COLLEGE BOY
                         What's with the awkward silence?

                         when my boss pulled that one on me.

               Then, a sound. All eyes turn.

                                     CHIEF
                         What was that?

                         Once was plenty, fellas.

                                     CHIEF
                         Shhhh...

               As Chief moves forward, pulling out his pick-axe.

               Instantly, the cave is illuminated by a white floodlight. A 
               group of GREENPEACE HIPPIE ACTIVISTS stand in the cave, 
               CHAINED TOGETHER at the waist, startling the men into screams.

               MEAN GREEN (35, crooked glasses on a face that has launched 
               a thousand craps) barks into a MINI BULLHORN that hangs around 
               her neck. She charges towards Chief.

                                     MEAN GREEN
                         Stop it right there! You will not 
                         rape Mother Nature one more day!

               Panicked, Chief drops his pick-axe and stumbles back.

                                     CHIEF
                         Whoa! Whoa! Whoa!

               In unison, the hippies start CHANTING.

                                     HIPPIE GROUP
                         Mother Nature is not a whore/Don't 
                         dump in her any-more/Mother Nature 
                         is not a whore/Don't dump in her any-
                         more...

               A BEARDED CAMERAMAN with a huge KEY RING on his belt, films 
               the whole event. The three men are stopped in their tracks.  

                                     CHIEF
                         Take it easy! We have a permit!

                                     MEAN GREEN
                              (handing a document)
                         And we have an injunction from the 
                         State to prevent any dumping in these 
                         caverns! This is virgin land! The 
                         aqueducts in these caves bring 
                         drinking water to our families, and 
                         its piping provides drainage for our 
                         farms that enrich this barren land! 
                         And it won't be tainted by waste of 
                         any kind! Not now! Not ever!

               Chief, shaken, confirms the injunction and hands it back.

                                     CHIEF
                         Fine, just back off!

               He snaps his fingers, motioning to the barrel.

                                     CHIEF
                         Let's roll... Now-now-now!

               Backing away, looking to Mean Green.

                                     CHIEF
                         How do you guys always know where 
                         we're going?

                                     MEAN GREEN
                              (with a smirk)
                         I'll tell ya next time! NOW MOVE IT!

               Hastily, the men roll the barrel out of the cave.

                                     MEAN GREEN
                         Score one for the green team!!!

               The hippies let out a spirited cheer. One pulls out a 
               tambourine, drums the beat for KUM BI YA. The rest join in 
               the victorious chant as they watch the three men hop in their 
               truck and peel away.

                                     BEARDED CAMERAMAN
                         Hey, man, that was righteous, but I 
                         need a shot with the sign up.

               At the end of the human chain, an earthy woman, FUZZY, moves 
               to hang a GREENPEACE sign. Mean Green strokes the cave wall.

                                     MEAN GREEN
                         We saved you today, ol' gal.

               Fuzzy hammers the sign in, but hits too hard, causing a breach 
               in the rock wall.

                                     FUZZY
                         Oh, fuck!

                                     MEAN GREEN
                         Sister, why do you always swing for 
                         the fences?

                                     FUZZY
                              (eyeing breach)
                         It's okay, but I... I think I see 
                         something in there... something shiny.

               Fuzzy puts her face up to the hole for a closer look. The 
               rest of the hippie-chain moves in closer.

                                     FUZZY
                         Oh my, it looks like diamonds!

               CHOMP! A set of giant, ravenous teeth bite into Fuzzy's skull. 
               Blood SPLATTERS on the hippies.

               Bearded Cameraman jumps to pull Fuzzy from the breach.

               Fuzzy's body is YANKED into the hole. The group tumbles 
               forward.

               Mean Green tries to stop herself from sliding, but can't.

               One by one, the hippies are being dragged to their death.

               Ripping, tearing, and howling echoes off the walls.

               Bearded Cameraman stumbles back. Mean Green spots him.

                                     MEAN GREEN
                         Give me the keys!!!

               Bearded Camerman just stares at her in shock. He's missing 
               both his arms.

               Mean Green lunges and grabs Chief's dropped pick-axe. She 
               HAMMERS at the chain around her waist.

               Foot by foot, she's dragged closer. At the last second, she 
               BREAKS the chain, popping herself free.

               She spins, running for safety. A guttural HOWL behind her 
               fills the cavern. Mean Green sprints toward the cave opening. 
               She's gonna make it. Only a few more feet. And then... JERK!

               Something grabs her neck and YANKS her back into the darkness. 
               The whiplash sends her bloody BULLHORN flying into the light. 
               As it lands, it lets out one last weak HONK...

               Bozo passes a man dressed in a cheap suit and standing well

                              (into pay phone)
                         They took my laptop with my PowerPoint

               Beer Guy (kinda handsome... just kinda) sets a keg of beer 
               behind the bar. Freeze on him.

               NAME: BEER GUY 
               AGE: 32 
               OCCUPATION: BEER GUY/PART-TIME HOST AT RED LOBSTER 
               LIFE EXPECTANCY: WIMPS AND DORKS ARE THE FIRST TO GO... HE'S 
               BOTH

               He talks with BARTENDER (thinning hair, chiseled face, big 
               earring) who preps a drink.

                                     BEER GUY
                         I mean, we'd been together for so 
                         long and then... bang! She drops me. 
                         Since then, it's been like a damn 
                         country song: she's gone, the car's 
                         repossessed, and a father figure 
                         made a pass at me. I'm not saying I 
                         ever had it. But I have definitely 
                         lost it.
                              (beat)
                         Now I haul this swill from armpit to 
                         armpit. I used to be a model for 
                         Christ's sake.

               Coach has been eavesdropping on Beer Guy and approaches.

                                     COACH
                         For what, may I ask?

                                     BEER GUY
                         JC Penny. Spring wear.

               Beer Guy then mimics throwing a sport coat over his shoulder 
               and delivering his "model" cheese smile.

                                     COACH
                         You know, Chach, catching you at 
                         this low point is pure serendipity.

                                     BEER GUY
                         Why is that?

                                     COACH
                         Because I take the rubble of man and 
                         build superstars. In my briefcase 
                         here is a doorway to a self-help 
                         sensation. Give me a minute, because 
                         I'd like to buy you a drink and change 
                         your life forever. I have a brochure --

                                     BARTENDER
                         Save it. We don't deal in pamphlets 
                         'round here. We stick to chemistry. 
                         And his drinks are on me.

               Bartender puts a shot in front of Beer Guy. Behind him, a 
               mounted DEER HEAD is prominently displayed. Freeze on him.

               NAME: BARTENDER 
               AGE: 50 
               OCCUPATION: BARTENDER 
               FUN FACT: SHOT 4 TIMES, STABBED 6 TIMES, BIT BY 1 SQUIRREL 
               LIFE EXPECTANCY: READY TO WEAR

               With Coach stumped, Bartender turns to Beer Guy.

                                     BARTENDER
                         Was that the last keg?

                         Yup, one keg of Beast for the 
                         basement, then the truck's dry.

                                     BARTENDER
                         If you're stayin', move the truck, 
                         boss gets pissed about you using 
                         primo parking.

                                     BEER GUY
                         Right, 'cause this joint's hopping.

               He hits a button and the keg slowly lowers to the basement.

               There is a HOLLER at the top of the stairs. Everyone turns.

                                     HEROINE
                         No sign of any weaknesses. No sign 
                         at all. He's an eating machine.
